studies.title: Tassili n'Ajjer
studies.caption: Wind-worn sandstone towers and sheltered passages rise above the plateau.
studies.prompt: Ground-level view among Tassili n'Ajjer's weathered sandstone towers, narrow sandy corridor, rounded wind-eroded arches and dark shelter overhang at side. Focus geology, no fabricated rock-art panels or caravans, no giant smooth red dunes.
